title: VPN connects but I cannot reach staging
body: Green shield, connected on home wifi, but staging-db.internal times out. Worked yesterday.
resolution: Confirm Route private ranges is on under Settings > Routing, restart the client.

title: VPN passes no traffic on hotel wifi
body: Client says connected but nothing loads. Hotel wifi in Denver.
resolution: Toggle wifi, reconnect. Known hotel captive-portal issue.

title: Need read access to the analytics warehouse
body: Starting on the reporting project Monday. Need warehouse-read.
resolution: Request warehouse-read in the portal with a reason; data platform lead approves within a day.

title: Access request stuck for a week
body: warehouse-write requested last Tuesday, still pending.
resolution: Portal shows it waiting on manager approval; manager is on leave, delegated to their lead.

title: uv sync removed my packages
body: Ran uv sync this morning, now ModuleNotFoundError: spacy. Installed it last week.
resolution: A plain uv sync drops optional groups. Use make setup, which keeps them.

title: torch will not install on my Mac
body: 2019 MacBook Pro, uv sync fails building torch wheel.
resolution: Intel Mac. Pin torch<2.3 or use the cloud model this week.

title: Qdrant storage folder already accessed
body: Notebook errors with 'already accessed by another instance'.
resolution: Another kernel holds the folder. Restart it.

title: Need admin rights to install a tool
body: Trying to install a network scanner, needs admin.
resolution: Request admin-laptop with justification; IT security approves within a day. Check the software centre first.

title: Laptop stolen from car
body: Bag taken this evening, laptop inside.
resolution: Called security line; device wiped remotely. Replacement requested.

title: Locked out after phone change
body: New phone, authenticator app gone, cannot sign in.
resolution: Verified by phone call to registered number; bypass code issued. Register the new device.

title: Account locks every hour with no attempts from me
body: Keep getting locked, I am not typing anything wrong.
resolution: Old saved credential on a second laptop retrying. Removed. Reported to security.

title: How do I see who my request is waiting on
body: Filed an access request, no updates.
resolution: The portal shows the pending approver on the request page.

title: Two VPN clients installed, neither works
body: Old client from last year plus the new one.
resolution: Remove the old client, reboot, reconnect.

title: Who approves prod-deploy
body: Need to deploy the billing fix.
resolution: Release manager, after a change review. Open the change first.

title: Wheel downloads hang on office network
body: uv sync sits at resolving for ten minutes.
resolution: Set HTTPS_PROXY from the intranet networking page.

title: Laptop not backed up for 30 days warning
body: Been on a client site, mostly offline.
resolution: Connect to VPN for an hour; backup runs automatically.

title: Self-service reset sends code to old number
body: Changed phone number in March.
resolution: Helpdesk verified with manager, updated the number, reset completed.

title: Need staging-deploy for a contractor
body: Contractor starts Monday.
resolution: Team lead requests it on the contractor's behalf; same day.

title: VPN slow on video calls
body: Calls drop when VPN is connected.
resolution: Video traffic should not route through the VPN; Route private ranges only. Check Settings > Routing.

title: Resolved ticket, problem is back
body: Fixed last week, same error today.
resolution: Reply on the resolved ticket within seven days and it reopens.
